messages.subject: Issues with data loading
parts:
Hi All, 

I am currently using the GGIR (for the first time) to analyse the wrist accelerometer data. I have got the following issues: 
1 - Does the code read csv formats only? If no, where to change the code to read other formats? 
2 - In any formats, which accelerometer data (x- y- or z-axis) should be imported? 
3 - Shall I only provide the GGIR with the accelerometer data in csv? Couldn't the csv file contain other data (i.e., frame number)?
3 - Are there any MATLAB or Python package for GGIR (VERY IMMPORTANT)? 
4 - How to access to the package codes (I am a beginner with R)? 

Does anyone know how to help me?
Looking forward to your replies. 

Kind regards, 
Javad

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: Re: Issues with data loading
parts:
Hi Javad,

- Please take some time to read the vignette which provides extensive information related to most of your questions: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html
- You can use  read.myacc.csv to read your own .csv files. other files like .bin, .cwa and .gt3x are automatically recognised by GGIR.
- If you are a beginner with R, the package codes may be difficult to interpret. However, they are completely accessible here if you wish to see them: https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/tree/master/R

Kind regards,
Ben
